svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The four runs of the L22 to L23 Lab. Steps 7 to 13, tapers: the Hann trace is wider than the uniform trace and its peak sits lower. Steps 14 to 16, grating lobes: with Rx1, Rx4 and Rx7 on, three full-height lobes. Steps 17 to 18, squint: with the source at 45 degrees, the 500 MHz trace peaks a few degrees past the 10 MHz trace. Steps 19 to 21, quantization: a Blackman beam held at 15 degrees; at 2 bits a lobe rises out of the floor. Each thumbnail is the array factor at 10.0 GHz, clipped at an example noise floor.
